subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): update ssrf-runtime import path in cdp-proxy-bypass

question: Should this regression fix preserve `ssrf-runtime-internal` as owner-scoped private helper access for Browser/Ollama, or promote `fetchConfiguredLocalOriginWithSsrFGuard` and `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` into public `ssrf-runtime`?
rationale: The observable regression is clear, but the PR changes the Plugin SDK and SSRF/proxy-bypass security boundary; automation cannot decide that public contract direction from code alone.

options.title: Preserve owner-scoped private access
options.body: Keep these helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias or staging path, with package lazy-load proof.

options.title: Approve public SDK promotion
options.body: Land the public `ssrf-runtime` exports only with explicit SDK/security approval, docs/API metadata, replacement guardrails, and release-note context.

options.title: Choose a canonical replacement
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers pick a sibling PR or new replacement branch as the canonical repair for the same regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve owner-scoped private access
recommendation.body: Keep these helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias or staging path, with package lazy-load proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The blocking decision is package/SDK boundary policy, and history ties this person to the private SDK declaration hardening and adjacent merge decisions.
